s7-recursive-implementation-of-atoi.trick: Skip leading spaces, read an optional sign, and recursively consume digits. Clamp as soon as the signed value would exceed 32-bit range.

s7-pow-x-n.trick: Exponentiation by squaring: compute the half-power once, square it, and multiply by x only for an odd exponent. Use a wider exponent for INT_MIN.

s7-count-good-numbers.trick: Even-indexed positions have 5 even-digit choices (0, 2, 4, 6, 8); odd-indexed positions have 4 prime-digit choices (2, 3, 5, 7). Multiply the counts using modular exponentiation.

s7-sort-a-stack-using-recursion.trick: Remove the top, sort the rest recursively, then insert the removed value into its sorted position. Largest ends on top.

s7-reverse-a-stack-using-recursion.trick: Remove the top, reverse the remaining stack, then place the removed value at the bottom.

s7-generate-all-binary-strings.trick: At each position choose 0 or 1; each root-to-leaf path is one length-n binary string.

s7-generate-paranthesis.trick: Add '(' while fewer than n opens have been used; add ')' only when it cannot make the prefix invalid.
s7-generate-paranthesis.time: O(n · Cₙ), Cₙ is the nth Catalan number

s7-print-all-subsequences-power-set.trick: For each element, branch into exclude and include. Each leaf represents one subsequence.

s7-learn-all-patterns-of-subsequences-th.trick: The include/exclude recursion is the common template. Return a boolean to stop at one valid subsequence instead of collecting all of them.

s7-count-all-subsequences-with-sum-k.trick: Include or exclude every element and count leaves whose sum equals k. Works even when values are negative.

s7-check-if-there-exists-a-subsequence-w.trick: Return true as soon as either include or exclude branch finds a subsequence summing to k; do not prune by sum when negatives are possible.

s7-combination-sum.trick: Sort distinct positive candidates. At each index either reuse the current value or move to the next candidate; stop when the remaining target is too small.
s7-combination-sum.time: Exponential in target and candidate count; output-sensitive
s7-combination-sum.space: O(target / min candidate) call stack, excluding output

s7-combination-sum-ii.trick: Sort candidates and try each remaining element once. At a recursion depth, skip repeated equal values to avoid duplicate combinations.
s7-combination-sum-ii.time: O(2^n · n) worst case, including copying answers

s7-subset-sum-i.trick: For every element choose include or exclude; at a leaf record the accumulated sum, then sort all sums.
s7-subset-sum-i.space: O(2^n) output and O(n) call stack

s7-subset-sum-ii.trick: Sort first. At each depth, emit the current subset and skip later equal values at that same depth.

s7-combination-sum-iii.trick: Choose increasing numbers from 1 through 9. Stop when k numbers are chosen or the remaining target is impossible.

s7-letter-combinations-of-a-phone-number.trick: Map each digit from 2 to 9 to its letters and recurse through one digit at a time, appending each possible letter.

s7-palindrome-partitioning.trick: Precompute which substrings are palindromes, then backtrack from each position using only palindromic prefixes.
s7-palindrome-partitioning.time: O(n² + n · 2^n) worst case, including output
s7-palindrome-partitioning.space: O(n²) palindrome table plus recursion, excluding output

s7-word-search.trick: Try every board cell as the first letter. DFS through four neighbors, temporarily marking used cells so a path cannot reuse one cell.

s7-n-queen.trick: Place one queen per row while marking occupied columns and both diagonal directions. Backtrack after each placement.
s7-n-queen.time: O(n! · n) worst case including board output
s7-n-queen.space: O(n²) board plus O(n) markers, excluding output

s7-rat-in-a-maze.trick: DFS from the top-left to bottom-right, marking the current cell visited. Explore D, L, R, U for lexicographically ordered paths.
s7-rat-in-a-maze.space: O(n²) visited state and recursion, excluding output

s7-m-coloring-problem.trick: Assign colors vertex by vertex. Reject any color already used by a colored neighbor, and backtrack if later vertices cannot be colored.

s7-sudoko-solver.trick: Track used digits for rows, columns and 3×3 boxes with bitmasks. At each step choose the empty cell with the fewest legal digits.
s7-sudoko-solver.time: O(9^E) worst case, E empty cells

s7-expression-add-operators.trick: Try every next number without leading zeros. Track both the evaluated total and the last signed term so multiplication can replace that term with term×value.
s7-expression-add-operators.space: O(n) recursion and expression, excluding output

s7-word-break.trick: Let dp[i] mean the prefix ending before i can be segmented. Try only dictionary word lengths from each reachable prefix.
s7-word-break.time: O(n · L²) with substring copying, L maximum word length
